text:
Hi everyone,

The last time my partner visited Israel, he apparently overstayed the period he was granted on entry (it was only 12 days this time, unlike the 90 days he had been granted on previous visits). He did, however, leave Israel before the usual 90-day period would have expired.

We would now like to start the process for a partner visa while he is outside Israel.

What would be the best way to start the process, and where should we apply or contact first?

Any advice or recommendations from people who have gone through a similar process would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you!
